definition: giving the impression that something harmful or evil is happening
hook: Sinister used to just mean which hand you wrote with.
modernAnchor: A shadow in a doorway. A smile that doesn't reach the eyes. We call it sinister.
journey: Roman augurs read bird flight to predict the will of the gods before battles and decisions.
Birds that flew on the right were favorable. Birds that flew on the left were sinister. Unlucky.
Left-handed people were treated as cursed. Witches were said to hold the devil's left hand.
Centuries of superstition turned a direction into a feeling. Left became wrong became evil.
